# Jared Furtado

> Jared Furtado is a full stack developer based in Goa, India. He specialises in the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and Next.js, builds production websites and web applications for clients as a freelancer, and is a student at Goa College of Engineering. He is available for freelance projects worldwide and open to full-time roles, including remote.

Website: https://jaredfurtado.tech/
Email: jaredfurtadowork@gmail.com
Location: Goa, India (works remotely worldwide)

## Services
- Full stack web applications: end-to-end MERN and Next.js builds — data model, API, authentication and a fast, responsive interface.
- Website rebuilds & modernisation: migrating live sites to modern stacks with better performance, multilingual support and conversion-focused UX.
- Technical SEO & discoverability: structured data, Open Graph, sitemaps and crawlability.

## Client work
- [Global Tourist Centre](https://globaltouristcentre.com/): End-to-end Next.js rebuild of a live tourism website. Added multilingual support (German, French, Russian, Italian), a WhatsApp Business widget, promotional pop-ups and countdown timers, with SEO improvements. Stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, i18n.
- [Techjeeva](https://findfund.vercel.app/): Portal built for FIIRE Forum (Forum for Innovation, Incubation, Research and Entrepreneurship) that aggregates Indian government funding schemes for startups and entrepreneurs, filterable by sector and eligibility. Stack: React, Tailwind CSS, Google Apps Script API. Source: https://github.com/jjf2009/Techjeeva-

## Personal projects
- [IntentOS](https://github.com/jjf2009/IntentOS): AI-powered, intent-driven interface that generates workflows from what the user wants to do. Stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Tambo AI.
- [Ride Buddy](https://github.com/jjf2009/RideBuddy_Forntend): Campus carpooling platform for Goa College of Engineering students with live location, Firebase authentication and route maps. Stack: React, Redux, Firebase, Leaflet.
- [OpenCV Projects](https://github.com/jjf2009/OpenCV_Projects): Real-time computer vision tools — object detection, hand-gesture tracking and face recognition — running locally. Stack: Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, YOLO.
- [Nike Landing Page](https://nike-landing-lac.vercel.app/): Responsive, pixel-accurate landing page clone. Stack: React, Tailwind CSS, Vite.

## Experience
- Freelance Web Developer, self-employed (Dec 2025 – present): client projects above; SEO implementation (schema markup, Open Graph, robots.txt, XML sitemaps).
- Sales Intern, Avyott, North Goa (Dec 2025 – Jan 2026): B2B outreach for a text AI agent product; generated two qualified leads.
- Event Coordinator, GEC Coders Club, Goa College of Engineering (Jul 2025 – present): runs technical workshops and coding competitions and mentors junior students.

## Skills
JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Prisma, Supabase, Redux, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs, i18n, Python, OpenCV, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
